zh-CN.title: 恢复抖音与小红书链接解析
items: 抖音、小红书链接改用新解析服务，支持视频及图文预览。
VIP 每周共可解析 7 次；有效缓存免费查看，过期刷新计入当前请求者额度。

en.title: Douyin and RedNote link previews return
items: Douyin and RedNote links now use a new media resolution service.
VIP includes 7 resolutions per week. Valid cached previews are free; refreshes count toward the requester’s quota.
